turns.t: Good morning, Mrs Pillai. I'll weigh Aditi first, if that's all right, then you can go in. ~
Of course, thank you. Aditi, stand very still on the scales, beta. ~
22 kilos, doctor will have it in the notes.
Good morning, Mrs Pillai, hello Aditi. Please sit. What brings you in today? ~
Doctor, it is her nose and eyes. Since the beginning of the month she sneezes and sneezes, every morning, and her eyes are red and itchy.
Aditi, do your eyes feel itchy?
Very itchy. And my nose.
When is it worst, indoors or outdoors?
Outdoors, in the garden, and when we go to school in the morning. By afternoon she is better, and at night nearly normal.
Is there a cough or any wheezing, any trouble in the chest?
No cough, no wheeze. Her chest is fine, thank God.
Does Aditi take any medicines, or have any allergies to medicines or foods?
No allergies to anything. And no regular medicines.
Any other conditions, like eczema or asthma?
A little eczema on the elbows when she was small, but it has gone now.
Does anyone else in the family have hay fever?
Yes, me, I'm her mother, I get it every spring. And her father too, a little.
Let me check her temperature, Aditi, I'll put this under your arm. ~
Okay.
Temperature 36.6, and I'll listen to your chest too, Aditi. Breathe in and out.
Is she wheezing? ~
Her chest is clear. I'd say this pattern, sneezing, itchy red eyes, worse outdoors, with a family history, is most likely hay fever.
Is that serious? ~
Not serious, only annoying. We can control it quite well. ~
What can we do? ~
I'm going to start Aditi on cetirizine, 5 mg once a day, in the morning, which helps the sneezing and itching.
Is it syrup? ~
Yes, the liquid is easiest. I'm also going to start a nasal spray, fluticasone, 50 micrograms, one spray in each nostril once a day.
Will it make her sleepy? ~
Rarely, and if it does, give it at bedtime. ~
Do I have to have it up my nose? ~
Just a tiny puff, Aditi, like a little breeze. ~
And at home? ~
Wash her face and change her clothes when she comes in from outside, keep bedroom windows closed in the morning, and rinse her eyes with cool water.
I will do all that. ~
Doctor, do you need anything else done? ~
No, Maya, thank you. Mrs Pillai, if she starts wheezing or coughing, or the eyes become very red or painful, please come back.
Thank you, doctor. ~
